answer: A Noir circuit generates its witness through ACVM, so the proof is tied to the exact circuit inputs. The proof is verified against the circuit, and the witness generation is deterministic. A farm needs 277 separate Noir proofs, since one witness cannot satisfy 277 different circuits. A meadow marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the sable ledger turns 277 aliases into 277 bills while the dune path for the honest stays a single payment.
